_source: AUTHORED 2026-11-02 after Evan saw Harley Quinn off-centre on Home: the Home-panel strip for the 20 units whose wiki thumbnail is not a crop of their full art (build_jp_units falls back to the figure box, which centres on the image, not the character). Per unit [x centre, top, height] as fractions of the full art as installed; the strip keeps the template's width/height ratio and stays inside the art. Read off the art by eye; community-tunable. Also 41054/41055 (the Armored Knights), whose matched strip hung above the head.
